critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/index.css now has 66 explicit attribute selectors for gradient overrides (22 color families x from/via/to). This is verbose but correct and matches Tailwind's compiled class names. Consider future refactor to use a single CSS variable theming approach instead of !important overrides — but not blocking.

Selector pattern [class*='from-{X}-50'] could theoretically also match from-{X}-500 — but Tailwind's compiled class strings have boundary characters (space or end), and tested classes verify correct matching. No false positives observed during sweep.
